_doc: Claude account split (auth-split PR1). accounts: Keychain items holding a long-lived token (type oauth -> CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, apikey -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); no secrets live in this file. daemons: launchd label (XPC_SERVICE_NAME) -> account id; EMPTY in PR1, so nothing changes. "*": the default for an unmapped com.we.* / com.plateau.* label: "refuse" (never fall back to /login), but it is only effective when enforce is true (false in PR1). Interactive and non-launchd sessions always resolve to none.
